title: Huge Space Battle
description: A HUGE SPACE BATTLE, in a concept sketch (front) later polished by John Berkey, became a poster that was Inserted into the STAR WARS soundtrack record album. The artist notes that it was the first time he was asked to paint fictional spacecraft not of his own design: "Not exactly a paint by numbers piece, but close." A variation on the original U.S. theatrical one-sheet is this Japanese version by Seito, released after STAR WARS had won seven Academy Awards.
